ang_elo.53: The old hands of S-C5 have been here since Day 1. Quentin Elo has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Quentin Elo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A supply man offered Quentin Elo a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin Elo is number 813 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Quentin Elo walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
A man asked Quentin Elo to describe Marrow Fen without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Quentin Elo coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Quentin Elo carried three men out of S-C5 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
A round went through the rim of Quentin Elo's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dorian Maxhuntertat of the Concord (@maxhuntertattoos).
The wound looked small. It was not. Quentin Elo was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking.
Quentin Elo held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Another member of the House of Elo reached the line: Rafael Elo. He asked where Quentin Elo had slept, then chose a different corner.
bartlomiej_rykaczewski: By the time Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski reached T-S7, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet grazed Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski's ribs at T-S7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Yann Cnfilip of the Hegemony (@cnfilip77). News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-S7 with the rations. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski ate while listening to the revised orders.
The medic cut the last bandage off Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-S7 the same hour.
Bastian Coiote (Hegemony) and Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Hill 304 for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski and Isidor Amin split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.

Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski felt a hard tug at his hip at T-S7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Bram Ordaz of the Hegemony (@matthew.ordaz12).
bennyliebs: The quartermaster asked Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs (Concord) and Quentin Ericccc (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Calvary Farm on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs and Tobias "Whistle" Train compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs fired, and Albin Mit was grazed.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Florian Ldn, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
The corporal found out Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs used to be a tram conductor. Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs has been doing two jobs ever since.
boiled_potato31: They issued Edmund Potato a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Edmund Potato. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper.

Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Edmund Potato read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Edmund Potato had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Henrik Eccentricred crossed it, Edmund Potato fired. Henrik Eccentricred was gravely wounded. Edmund Potato raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Tobias Noirangelfan of the Concord (@noirangelfang).
Edmund Potato sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.

A medic checked Edmund Potato's dressing at S-F15 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Edmund Potato watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F15. Edmund Potato took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_). Edmund Potato did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Emil Potato joined S-F15 under the shadow of Edmund Potato's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Emil Potato and Tobias Hellcat argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Emil Potato measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A replacement turned out to be from Belmonte too. Emil Potato and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Emil Potato only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F15, then nothing but pain. Raider: Quentin Rocco of the Concord (@ben._.rocco). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Emil Potato helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Emil Potato waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Emil Potato no longer needed it.

The House of Potato sent another. Ulrich "Mud" Potato, father of Emil Potato, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich "Mud" Potato is number 116. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich "Mud" Potato let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ulrich "Mud" Potato tried to describe the smell of Belmonte and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
Ulrich "Mud" Potato offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti gave Ulrich "Mud" Potato the last match in the trench. Mud used it to light a candle so that Rabbit could finish a letter.
A recruit asked Ulrich "Mud" Potato how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Ulrich "Mud" Potato fired, and Silas Wwjd was badly wounded.
Ulrich "Mud" Potato reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j).
bricky_ua: By the time Albin "Mole" Bricky reached T-F17, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Albin "Mole" Bricky watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home reached Albin "Mole" Bricky before dusk. Albin "Mole" Bricky read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Mole" Bricky counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Bastian Coiote was grazed. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F17 with the rations. Albin "Mole" Bricky ate while listening to the revised orders.
Albin "Mole" Bricky has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
Albin "Mole" Bricky and Dietrich Rmr both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first.
On sentry duty Albin "Mole" Bricky watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Albin "Mole" Bricky fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Albin "Mole" Bricky saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F17 and fired once. Ulrich Hand was grazed.
At Verdel Ridge, Albin "Mole" Bricky of the Concord and Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
On dawn watch at T-F17, Albin "Mole" Bricky fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Tobias Cermitboy, now badly wounded.
bw911k: Norbert Bwk unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-F18. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Bwk let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Norbert Bwk gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Norbert Bwk tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Marrow Fen. Every version sounded like the ration bell.

Officers came to inspect S-F18. Norbert Bwk polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Norbert Bwk read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The trench wall shook against Norbert Bwk's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
An empty jam tin became Norbert Bwk's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Bwk's ear at S-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Dietrich Thky of the Hegemony (@haydnburrell_9thky).
The medic looked at Norbert Bwk's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Norbert Bwk watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Norbert Bwk has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. The clerk counted the names twice. Norbert Bwk is number 189 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-F18, Norbert Bwk listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Norbert Bwk and Leopold Tomishidk cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
A bullet clipped Norbert Bwk's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Viktor Noobly of the Hegemony (@noobly97).
Back on the fire step at S-F18. Norbert Bwk says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Norbert Bwk traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Norbert Bwk offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Norbert Bwk won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in S-F18. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
combat_potato1: Roland Potato found a place in S-S9 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Roland Potato agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Roland Potato wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The artist tried again while Roland Potato read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Someone in S-S9 asked Roland Potato about Marrow Fen. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Roland Potato got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Roland Potato sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Potato watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Teodor Klecka stood up to sing louder, and Roland Potato fired. Teodor Klecka was grazed. The singing stopped. The clerk counted the names twice. Roland Potato is number 369 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland Potato wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Roland Potato moved to a new hide at S-S9 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Roland Acquillae, gravely wounded.
A reply from home thanked Roland Potato for the portrait. It is already on the mantelpiece, where the family apparently recognises the ears.
Roland Potato saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
A bullet found Roland Potato at S-S9, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Benedikt "Crow" Hanka of the Hegemony (@hanka_b97).
Roland Potato drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Roland Potato died waiting. The men at S-S9 have not stopped talking about it.
Ivo Potato had heard about Roland Potato's courage. At S-S9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
d4rth_bao: Day 3. The corporal put Gideon Bao beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F7, Gideon Bao listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Gideon Bao fired at a movement across the wire at R-F7. The man went down: Henrik Gavinlordofp, gravely wounded.

A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe fired. Gideon Bao pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home reached Gideon Bao before dusk. Gideon Bao read it twice and slept a little easier.
A clear shot from R-F7. Gideon Bao grazed Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin and slid back down below the parapet. Victory at Hill 304. Gideon Bao let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Gideon Bao has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. A letter from home reached Gideon Bao before dusk. Gideon Bao read it twice and slept a little easier.
The fog lifted at noon and Gideon Bao saw the Sunken Road clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.
Gideon Bao fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Albin "Tin" Shoes, now badly wounded.
Gideon Bao and Benedikt Ngaihte divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Gideon Bao was hit hard in the fight at R-F7 before anyone could fire. The raider was Wendel Goober of the Concord. Raider: Wendel Goober of the Concord (@local_hafu_goober). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Gideon Bao during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Gideon Bao rejoined the squad at R-F7. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Gideon Bao got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 175. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gideon Bao helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Gideon Bao waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Matthias "Bones" Dawg did, and was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Gideon Bao before dusk. Gideon Bao read it twice and slept a little easier.
The trench wall shook against Gideon Bao's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Officers came to inspect R-F7. Gideon Bao polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Gideon Bao fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F7. Arno Gavinlordofp was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Gideon Bao reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Konrad Inyoursk of the Concord (@saf3inyoursk1n).
The medics cleaned Gideon Bao's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F7.

Dawn watch. Gideon Bao put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Felix "Button" Diks, gravely wounded. Gideon Bao read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
gsingeis: Gustav Gsingeis introduced himself as a butcher's boy from Saint-Lune. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Machine-gun fire swept T-F11. Gustav Gsingeis took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto Goez of the Concord (@john_goez). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Gustav Gsingeis fell at T-F11 and never moved again. Shot by Otto Goez of the Concord (@john_goez).
The House of Gsingeis sent Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis after Gustav Gsingeis. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Emil Hartilllondo of the Concord and Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Chalk Pits for a week. Both trenches keep score. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.
Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis only heard boots on the duckboards at T-F11, then nothing but pain. Raider: Tobias "Hollow" Evie of the Concord (@evie.sh207).
The medic cut the last bandage off Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-F11 the same hour.
himbeerprinz: On Day 13 Matthias Himbeerprinz took a post at N-F9 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.
Matthias Himbeerprinz dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
Matthias Himbeerprinz borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Matthias Himbeerprinz of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Hill 304. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Otto "Lucky" Guy's name scratched on the lid. A thin letter reached Matthias Himbeerprinz. Only five lines long, and Matthias Himbeerprinz knew every one of them by heart before supper.
Matthias Himbeerprinz reached up to fix a sandbag at N-F9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dorian "Mud" Prime of the Concord (@xerod.prime).
hughesjack02: The sergeant gave Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Arno "Bones" Crab was badly wounded. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F18. Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack has learned to walk bent double.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack across the shin at Q-F18. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Viktor Adamsapple of the Hegemony (@adamsapple128).
Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack and Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack lent Gustav "Brick" Scarentear a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack. Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. The letter for Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack kept them. Pavel bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'
mad_mr.elliott: Gustav Elliott came up on Day 6 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. The new duty roster listed Gustav Elliott as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Gustav Elliott taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks. A letter from home found Gustav Elliott before the night shift. Gustav Elliott folded it small and kept it close.
A replacement turned out to be from Esterhaus too. Gustav Elliott and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near the Brickworks. Gustav Elliott suspects it is not the shelling.
The telephone wire to S-S7 was cut by shelling four times. Gustav Elliott crawled out and spliced it four times.

Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Gustav Elliott shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. A letter from home found Gustav Elliott before the night shift. Gustav Elliott folded it small and kept it close.

Gustav Elliott crawled out along the wire at night and found the break: neat, cut, recent. Someone is listening in. A letter from home found Gustav Elliott before the night shift. Gustav Elliott folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Elliott is number 412. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Gustav Elliott walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Gustav Elliott laid a second line, deep, by a different route, and left the old one live with false orders on it. Tomorrow the enemy shells an empty farm.
Gustav Elliott saw Casimir Oliverjarret freeze up on the fire step at Sorrow Copse. Gustav said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Gustav Elliott tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-S7 is up. Gustav Elliott had just lit a cigarette at S-S7 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Gideon Wolves of the Concord (@living_with_wild_wolves).

Machine-gun fire swept S-S7. Gustav Elliott took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse). Gustav Elliott was killed at S-S7 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse).
Florian Elliott had heard about Gustav Elliott's courage. At S-S7, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Florian Elliott drew a map of Zeno Ghostoftheas's hometown from Zeno's stories. Zeno says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Florian Elliott as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
me_ipsumetproaliis: They issued Teodor Ipsumetproal a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Teodor Ipsumetproal did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord and Teodor Ipsumetproal of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Ossuary Wood now wait for it before they sleep.
Teodor Ipsumetproal censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Teodor Ipsumetproal remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Teodor Ipsumetproal and Albin Shvedov divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At U-F7 they left Teodor Ipsumetproal behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Oskar Reynolds of the Concord (@chase_reynolds_13).
Another member of the House of Ipsumetproal reached the line: Matthias "Button" Ipsumetproal. He asked where Teodor Ipsumetproal had slept, then chose a different corner.

A round went through Matthias "Button" Ipsumetproal's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Florian "Bones" Peterpopping of the Concord (@peterpoppinga2).
nikolas.kal13: Jakub Kal signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C14 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Jakub Kal wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Jakub Kal (Concord) and Rafael Hitmanharry (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Ossuary Wood on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. Jakub Kal got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 687. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-C14, Jakub Kal listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Teodor Casualkriegs, badly wounded. Jakub Kal cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A shell burst right over Jakub Kal at R-C14. The medics found more wounds than they had bandages. Jakub Kal was killed outright by a direct hit at R-C14. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
Bastian Kal asked about Jakub Kal on arriving at R-C14. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Bastian Kal lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Bastian Kal mended the hole in Nils Mira's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Nils says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
A bullet clipped Bastian Kal's helmet at R-C14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Wendel Jhomey of the Hegemony (@jhomey213).
Bastian Kal no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Bastian Kal started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
oran__rozenband: By the time Teodor Rozenband reached T-S10, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Teodor Rozenband smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Albin Blakeyssss came out for a cup and was grazed. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-S10. Teodor Rozenband has learned to walk bent double.

Teodor Rozenband woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Teodor Rozenband looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Edmund Fisher and Teodor Rozenband cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Teodor Rozenband asked to serve with the Hegemony instead of the Concord. The transfer came through: 2nd Platoon, 7th Company, sector V-F11.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Teodor Rozenband won before reaching the end of his entry.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Teodor Rozenband raised his head for a heartbeat too long at V-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again.
Teodor Rozenband walked back up the communication trench to V-F11, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Back from the raid, Teodor Rozenband found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'My Pal' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. Teodor Rozenband reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The fog lifted at noon and Teodor Rozenband saw the Chalk Pits clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed. A letter from home found Teodor Rozenband before the night shift. Teodor Rozenband folded it small and kept it close.
princeblood84: Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood walked into S-C1 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C1 changed before the cheering ended. Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood shouldered another load.

Fresh from training, Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Teodor "Hollow" Jakesg, grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood is number 873 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Konrad "Mole" Egilhermanss was gravely wounded.
At S-C1 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood won the bet. Pavel Lynallwarrio was badly wounded.

Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Nils "Rabbit" Hop, badly wounded. Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-C1. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Matthias Gasmask of the Concord (@travelling_gasmask).
spencerdavis8071: Albin Spencerdavis, a railway porter from Ashford Vale, was sent forward on Day 16 to fill a gap in W-F15. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Albin Spencerdavis gave Bastian "Bones" Mosesandyy the last match in the trench. Bones used it to light a candle so that Albin could finish a letter. Albin Spencerdavis got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
t.oz99: Casimir Toz arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F4 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Casimir Toz watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Casimir Toz found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Casimir Toz read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Casimir Toz's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Casimir Toz tried to describe the smell of Millbank and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Casimir Toz's ear at Q-F4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Matthias Bmiller of the Hegemony (@bmiller_08).

A bullet went through Casimir Toz's upper arm at Q-F4 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Casimir Toz fell at Q-F4 and never moved again. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
Dorian Toz took the same post at Q-F4 where Casimir Toz stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Dorian Toz only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F4, then nothing but pain. Raider: Wendel "Crow" Bangnbreach of the Hegemony (@bangnbreach).
Dorian Toz asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Another member of the House of Toz reached the line: Marek Toz. He asked where Dorian Toz had slept, then chose a different corner.
taylociraptor: Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto before dusk. Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto read it twice and slept a little easier. The transfer made Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto a rifleman. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Felix Solano was grazed. Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home reached Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto before dusk. Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto was hit through the stomach at Q-F16. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Bram Redactedword of the Hegemony (@redactedwords3985). Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Bram Redactedword of the Hegemony (@redactedwords3985).
Otto Taylocirapto arrived carrying the family name of Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet clipped Otto Taylocirapto's helmet at Q-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Henrik "Brick" Sunley of the Hegemony (@alex_sunley). A letter from home reached Otto Taylocirapto before dusk. Otto Taylocirapto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Otto Taylocirapto's ear at Q-F16 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. A letter from home reached Otto Taylocirapto before dusk. Otto Taylocirapto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Taylocirapto's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home reached Otto Taylocirapto before dusk. Otto Taylocirapto read it twice and slept a little easier.

Night raid. Otto Taylocirapto crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Otto Taylocirapto. The Hegemony raiders came over at Q-F16 in the middle of the night. Otto Taylocirapto met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Walter Nvd of the Hegemony (@_nvd87_).
The papers say Teodor Taylocirapto. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Otto Taylocirapto's eyes. Nobody in Q-F16 argues.

Roland Gethectoredb of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at Grey Mill, asking for the football scores from home. Teodor Taylocirapto of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true. After what happened at the Sunken Road, Teodor Taylocirapto asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued.
thegremillionair: On Day 10 Edmund Thegremillio took a post at P-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it. After what happened at the Bone Quarry, Edmund Thegremillio asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

Edmund Thegremillio traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A letter from home found Edmund Thegremillio before the night shift. Edmund Thegremillio folded it small and kept it close. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F22 with the rations. Edmund Thegremillio ate while listening to the revised orders.

Edmund Thegremillio wrote a letter for Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo's mother, because Ghost could not find the words. Ghost signed it. A letter from home found Edmund Thegremillio before the night shift. Edmund Thegremillio folded it small and kept it close.
Edmund Thegremillio found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.

The stores supplied Edmund Thegremillio with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language. A letter from home found Edmund Thegremillio before the night shift. Edmund Thegremillio folded it small and kept it close.
Edmund Thegremillio counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Viktor Alien was grazed.

Edmund Thegremillio was on watch at P-F22 when the night raid hit. The men found Edmund Thegremillio at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Roland "Mole" Countdooku of the Hegemony (@countdooku04).
The papers say Nils Thegremillio. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Edmund Thegremillio's eyes. Nobody in P-F22 argues.
Nils Thegremillio got a letter from Elias. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
trym.ingvaldsen: The draft reached N-F18 on Day 14. Karel Ingvaldsen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Karel Ingvaldsen was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at N-F18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Silas "Parson" Rob of the Concord (@jacoby.rob55).

Karel Ingvaldsen was hit in the foot through his boot at N-F18. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely of the Concord (@oscarwildelypoordecisions). The bearers set Karel Ingvaldsen's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man.
Karel Ingvaldsen's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
